text: Sign in users with GitHub, Google, Apple and 30+ other social OAuth providers enabled from the Console
quote: Enable 30+ social providers from the Console Social providers tab. Users sign up in one click with GitHub, Google, Apple, and the identity providers your audience already uses.

text: Email and password login in a few lines of code, with passwords hashed using Argon2
quote: Email and password login with just a few lines of code secured with state of the art Argon2 hashing.

text: Passwordless sign-in via Magic URL, Email OTP, and phone SMS verification
quote: Turn on Magic URL, Email OTP, and Phone SMS from Auth settings. Ship secure sign-in without storing or resetting passwords.

text: Guest sessions for anonymous visitors that can later be converted into full accounts
quote: Create guest sessions for visitors and convert to full accounts when they're ready.

text: Multi-factor authentication for app users
quote: Implementing MFA to add extra layers of security to your app.

text: Email a 6-digit code for email verification and password recovery without redirects or deep links
quote: Appwrite Auth can email a 6-digit code for email verification and password recovery, so mobile and desktop apps can handle both without a redirect page or a deep link.

text: Delegate a user's access by passing JWT tokens
quote: Deligate access for a user through passing JWT tokens.

text: Track active signed-in users and broadcast online, typing, and viewing status in realtime
quote: Track which signed-in users are active right now and broadcast online, typing, and viewing status in realtime.

text: Respond to server events in realtime
quote: Respond to server events in realtime.

text: Managed database with typed columns, rows, relationships, and indexes
quote: Structured, relational data with typed columns, rows, relationships, and indexes.

text: Store embeddings and run similarity search for AI features
quote: Store embeddings and run similarity search to power AI features.

text: Managed, dedicated PostgreSQL you connect to directly with psql, Prisma, or Drizzle, with pgvector support
quote: Host a managed PostgreSQL database on Appwrite. Connect with psql, Prisma, or Drizzle, install pgvector, and get backups, replicas, pooling, and PITR.

text: Managed PostgreSQL includes backups, replicas, connection pooling, and point-in-time recovery
quote: Connect with psql, Prisma, or Drizzle, install pgvector, and get backups, replicas, pooling, and PITR.

text: Choose shared serverless or dedicated compute per database, with usage-based or fixed monthly pricing
quote: Choose serverless or dedicated compute for each database. Pay for usage when traffic is variable, or pick a fixed monthly tier when you need reserved resources and predictable costs.

text: Choose between managed database APIs with permissions and realtime, or dedicated native engines
quote: Choose the database that fits your use case, from managed APIs with permissions and realtime to dedicated native engines you connect to directly.

text: Functions triggered by HTTP requests, SDK methods, server events, webhooks, and scheduled executions
quote: These Functions can be triggered by HTTP requests, SDK methods, server events, webhooks, and scheduled executions.

text: Run API endpoints, webhooks, cron jobs, and event handlers in secure isolated runtimes that scale with demand
quote: Run API endpoints, webhooks, cron jobs, and event handlers in secure isolated runtimes that scale with demand.

text: 13+ function runtimes, with local development before deploying
quote: 13+ runtimes. Develop locally, deploy when ready.

text: Storage APIs to upload, download, delete, and list files
quote: It provides APIs to upload, download, delete, and list files, with many added utilities.

text: Image preview endpoint to resize, crop, convert format, set quality, add borders, and rotate
quote: Use the preview endpoint to resize, crop, convert format, set quality, add borders, and rotate from a single upload.

text: Automatic smart cropping that focuses on detected faces (YuNet) or salient regions (U²-Net)
quote: Pass gravity=auto and YuNet looks for a face first. If none is confident enough, U²-Net saliency returns a normalized (x, y) crop focus.

text: Storage buckets can strip location, device, and capture-time metadata from uploaded images
quote: Storage buckets can now remove location, device, and capture time metadata from uploaded images.

text: Label and understand the contents of images
quote: Label and understand the contents of images

text: Generate icons, screenshots, and QR codes for apps
quote: Generate icons, screenshots, and QR codes for your apps.

text: Single Messaging service and SDK for sending email, SMS, and push notifications
quote: Send on every channel from one Messaging service and SDK. Use createEmail, createSms, and createPush for transactional mail, OTP codes, and mobile alerts without wiring three separate vendor integrations.

text: Schedule email, SMS, and push notifications
quote: Send and schedule email, SMS, and push notifications.

text: Messaging topics with subscribed targets for newsletters, announcements, and alerts
quote: Create topics from the Console Topics tab and subscribe targets for newsletters, product announcements, and security alerts.

text: Official MCP server that lets LLMs interact directly with Appwrite's API and docs
quote: Appwrite offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows LLMs to directly interact with Appwrite's API and docs.

text: Through MCP, agents can manage projects, rows, files, and users, and deploy Functions
quote: This includes creating and managing projects, managing resources (rows, files, users), creating and deploying Appwrite Functions, and other operations available through Appwrite's API.

text: Claude Code and Codex plugins bundle the hosted MCP server and need only one OAuth sign-in
quote: The Appwrite plugins for Claude Code and Codex now include the hosted Appwrite MCP server, so your agent can work with your Appwrite project after one OAuth sign-in.

text: Open-source Markdown skills that give AI agents accurate, language-specific knowledge of Appwrite SDKs
quote: skills provide your AI tools with accurate, language-specific context about Appwrite APIs, so they generate correct code without needing to look up documentation

text: Any documentation page is available as raw Markdown by appending .md to its URL
quote: You can access any documentation page as raw Markdown by appending `.md` to the URL.

text: Copy page button that copies any docs page as Markdown
quote: Every page in the Appwrite documentation includes a **Copy page** button that copies the entire page content as Markdown to your clipboard.

text: Official CLI for performing server-side tasks from the terminal
quote: The Appwrite Command Line Interface (CLI) is an application that allows you to interact with Appwrite to perform server-side tasks using your terminal.

text: CLI can run non-interactively and headlessly, without saved configuration or sessions, for CI automation
quote: The Appwrite CLI can be used in a non-interactive and headless manner, without saving configuration or sessions. This is especially useful when you want to automate tasks on a continuous integration server.

text: CLI generate command creates a type-safe SDK with typed helpers from your database schema
quote: The generate command creates a type-safe SDK tailored to your project. It detects your project's language and generates typed helpers based on your database schema.

text: CLI types command generates type definitions from the database schema
quote: The types command generates type definitions based on your Appwrite database schema.

text: Project config can split top-level resource arrays into separate JSON files using includes
quote: you can split top-level resource arrays into separate JSON files with the `includes` field.

text: Many official SDKs, plus REST and GraphQL APIs
quote: You can use one of our many SDKs or integrate directly through the REST API or GraphQL API.

text: Self-host on any OS that runs Docker, or on Kubernetes using the official Helm chart
quote: You can install and run Appwrite on any operating system that can run a Docker CLI, or on your own Kubernetes cluster with the official Helm chart.

text: One-click marketplace installations for self-hosted setup
quote: Use a one-click deployment - Choose from marketplace installations for instant setup

text: Full control over where data is located
quote: Full control over data location

text: One-click migrations from Firebase, Supabase, and NHost, and between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted
quote: One-Click migrations lets you migrate from Firebase, Supabase, and NHost. You can also migrate between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted.

text: Integrated web hosting with custom domains, SSR, Git integration, and previews
quote: Integrated hosting platform to deploy and scale web applications with support for custom domains, SSR, and seamless backend integration. Git integration and previews are supported.

text: Git-connected deploys: production branch auto-activates on push, other branches get preview links
quote: Connect GitHub or Origin and ship on every push. Commits to your production branch build and auto-activate on your primary domain; other branches get preview links for org members to review before merge.

text: Firewall rules created from ready-made presets
quote: Create Firewall rules from ready-made presets

text: SOC-2 and HIPAA compliance, with BAA available
quote: SOC-2, HIPAA, and BAA
